content.text: : block reuptake of NE, 5HT, or both from the synaptic cleft back into the presynaptic nerve terminal; also block histamine1, muscarinic, & alpha1 adrenergic receptors
•Tertiary Amines: more effective, but more side effects
•Secondary Amines: less side effects; less drowsiness, somnolence, & weight gain
•anticholinergic (MC) – dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, mydriasis, blurred vision, tachycardia
•cardiovascular: dose-dependent QT prolongation, orthostatic hypotension, conduction abnormalities, tachycardia
•CNS: seizures, fine tremor, sedation, sleep alterations, activation-like state, anxiety
•weight gain, confusion, edema, rash, worsening glaucoma
: concurrent use w/ MAOIs, concurrent use w/ Methyldopa & Clonidine
: do not D/C abruptly – cholinergic rebound

local anesthetics of the same chemical class
some preservatives: parabens or sulfites (including derivatives used as preservatives or antioxidants in multiple-dose vials)

: synthetic purine nucleoside analog with activity against HSV (types 1 and 2), varicella-zoster virus (VZV), and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV); stops replication of herpes viral DNA by competitive inhibition of viral DNA polymerase (selective toxicity), incorporation into and termination of the growing viral DNA chain, and inactivation of the viral DNA polymerase
Treatment of initial and recurrent mucosal and cutaneous HSV1 and HSV2 and VZV infections in immunocompromised patients (adults and children ≥12yr)
Acute treatment of herpes zoster (shingles) in immunocompetent adults
Acute treatment of varicella zoster (chicken pox) in immunocompetent children ≥2yr and adults when started within 24hr of onset of typical chickenpox rash
: IV (injection site inflammation or phlebitis, transient elevation of SCr/BUN, N/V), PO (GI disturbances, HA, skin rash)

: prodrug; converted to penciclovir in the gut wall and liver; penciclovir is phosphorylated by viral thymidine kinase to penciclovir monophosphate, which is then converted to penciclovir triphosphate by cellular kinases; triphosphate inhibits viral DNA synthesis
: has antiviral activity against HSV1/2, VZV, & EBV
Acyclovir for 10d may shorten the clinical course – approved as an antiviral for herpes infections
